description: Edit Cituna's stored copy of one AutoSEO article (`id` from list_articles). Pass only the fields to change. Each one overwrites that field, and `sections`, `faqs` and `tags` replace the whole list, so read the article with get_article first and send back every section to keep. A page already on the site does not change: it is updated when someone sends the article again from the Cituna app. An article held by the publishing checks is checked again on save, and the result says whether it still is. WRITE ACTION: requires a Pro plan or higher.

dek.description: The opening answer under the headline.

faqs.description: Every FAQ as {q, a}, replacing the FAQ block. An empty list removes it.

metaDescription.description: The meta description search results show.

metaTitle.description: The SEO title search results show.

sections.description: The whole body as {h2, body} sections, replacing every section. A body is plain text: a blank line between paragraphs, lines starting with "- " or "1. " for a list, [words](https://...) for a link, and no headings or bold.

title.description: The headline (H1). The URL does not change.

name: update_article
